# r/place

> A census study of how 706 Reddit communities organised on r/place in 2017, run with language-model agents. A coder codes each community as a case (Gioia and Eisenhardt); an aggregator builds one model across them. This repository holds both instruments, their handlers, the scripts that rebuild the data, and the aggregator's run, instrument v43.

Agents: read FOR-AGENTS.md before acting. Check with `bash verify.sh`. Figures that move are in Manual/numbers.md.

## Start

- [README.md](README.md): what is here, data availability, requirements, the steps in order, and where each input of the run comes from
- [FOR-AGENTS.md](FOR-AGENTS.md): rules, checks, and where the truth is
- [Manual/README.md](Manual/README.md): the Manual's front page and the run's progress
- [Manual/1-introduction.md](Manual/1-introduction.md): what the study asks

## The method

- [Manual/10-for-reviewers.md](Manual/10-for-reviewers.md): the tiers against Gioia's, which model did each step, how to check one room
- [Manual/trace-a-claim.md](Manual/trace-a-claim.md): one claim followed from the case account down to the Reddit item
- [Manual/census.md](Manual/census.md): from 1,473 artworks to 706 communities, and the judgements on the way
- [Manual/4-the-coder.md](Manual/4-the-coder.md), [Manual/5-the-aggregator.md](Manual/5-the-aggregator.md): each instrument

- [aggregator/handler/HANDLER.md](aggregator/handler/HANDLER.md): the aggregator's handler protocol

- [Manual/9-resuming.md](Manual/9-resuming.md): talking with a closed leg, and continuing a run
